key_insight: Detonation-spray parameters control the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based coatings, enabling selection of conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide spray-process tuning to achieve desired coating geometry and water repellency.
method: Vary detonation-spraying process conditions for titanium-dioxide-based metal-ceramic coatings.
Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive equations linking surface characteristics to nozzle travel speed and spray distance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships of roughness and thickness with nozzle travel speed, and parabolic relationships of roughness and contact angle with spray distance.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical parameter ranges or model errors, so predictive accuracy and transferability require verification.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
